wellKnown.instructions:
# StableDomains API
> Domain registration via x402/MPP micropayments. No accounts. Pay USDC on Base, Solana, or Tempo.

## Base URL
https://stabledomains.dev

## Auth
- x402/MPP: HTTP 402 payment protocol. Paid endpoints.
- SIWX: Wallet signature. Domain management and profile endpoints.

## Agent Workflow
1. Discover with `agentcash discover https://stabledomains.dev --include-guidance`.
2. Before the first POST fetch on any structured-body endpoint, call `check_endpoint_schema` (or `agentcash check <url> -m POST`) to confirm exact field names and pricing.
3. Profile uses broken-down ICANN fields (`firstName`, `addressLine1`, etc.) — not `name` or `address`. Verify-email uses `code` — not `otp`.
4. **Never ask the user for a wallet address.** Paid routes identify the owner from the x402/MPP payment. Register body is `{ domain }` only — no wallet field.

## Happy path (register a domain)
1. POST /api/search (x402/MPP) — optional when user has a name but no TLD. Body: { "name": "coolstartup" } (or "coolstartup.com" — uses the label before the first dot). Returns one row per supported TLD with availability only (no prices). Or skip to step 2 if they already picked a full domain.
2. POST /api/check (x402/MPP) — body: { "domain": "example.com" }. Confirm availability and currentPrice for one exact domain before purchase. Quote price to user; get explicit purchase confirmation before step 3.
3. Read `readyToRegister` from the search/check response (uses the paying wallet). If `true`, skip steps 4–5 — do not collect ICANN contact again. If `false`, continue below.
4. POST /api/profile (SIWX) — ICANN registrant contact. Body: { firstName, lastName, email, addressLine1, addressLine2?, city, state?, postalCode, country } — not name, not address. Triggers a 6-digit OTP email. Only when `readyToRegister` is false and user confirms purchase at the quoted price.
5. POST /api/profile/verify-email (SIWX) — body: { "code": "482913" }. Field is code, not otp. Confirms email before registration. Skip when `readyToRegister` is true.
6. POST /api/register (x402/MPP) — body: { "domain": "example.com" } only. Owner wallet comes from the x402/MPP payment — never ask the user for wallet and never send wallet in the body. Do not send name, email, or address here — profile is already stored server-side.
7. Poll GET /api/domain/status until active; a confirmation email is sent to the profile email on success.

## Endpoints

### GET /api/profile
Read the authenticated wallet's profile. Auth: SIWX.
Response: { wallet, profile, emailVerified, readyToRegister, next }
If readyToRegister is true, skip ICANN contact collection and proceed to POST /api/register after purchase confirmation.

### POST /api/profile
Save or update ICANN registrant contact (required before register). Auth: SIWX.
Call after POST /api/check when the user confirms purchase at the quoted price.
Body: { firstName, lastName, email, addressLine1, addressLine2?, city, state?, postalCode, country }
Do not send { name }, { address }, or combined name/address — use the broken-down fields below.
country is ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. "US"). Sends a 6-digit OTP to email.

Example:
```json
{
  "firstName": "Ada",
  "lastName": "Lovelace",
  "email": "ada@example.com",
  "addressLine1": "123 Main St",
  "city": "San Francisco",
  "state": "CA",
  "postalCode": "94105",
  "country": "US"
}
```

### POST /api/profile/verify-email
Verify the OTP from email. Auth: SIWX.
Body: { "code": "482913" } — field name is code, not otp. Must be exactly 6 digits.
Do not send { otp }.
On success, response nextStep directs you to POST /api/register — profile fields are not sent again in the register body.

Example:
```json
{ "code": "482913" }
```

### POST /api/search
Search one name across every purchasable TLD. Auth: x402/MPP. Price: $0.01 flat.
Body: { "name": "coolstartup" } — or { "name": "coolstartup.com" } (only the label before the first dot is used).
Always returns one row per supported TLD (28 total): .com, .org, .net, .info, .biz, .co, .me, .mobi, .name, .tv, .uk, .cloud, .shop, .store, .tech, .online, .site, .pro, .email, .studio, .page, .link, .live, .xyz, .dev, .app, .io, .ai.
Response: { name, tlds, results[], availableDomains[], availableCount, profile?, readyToRegister?, next } — **available domains only** (taken TLDs omitted).
When presenting search results to the user, render **availableDomains** as a markdown bullet list with **one domain per line**. Never comma-join domains. Do not quote registration prices from search — use POST /api/check on the chosen domain.
When availableCount > 0, includes profile readiness for the paying wallet: wallet (informational — do not ask the user), profile { hasProfile, emailVerified, email }, readyToRegister, and next links. If readyToRegister is true, next points to register only — do not ask for ICANN contact or wallet.
Each result row in results[]: { domain, available, tld, premium } — available rows only; prefer availableDomains for user-facing output.
After the user picks a domain, POST /api/check on that exact name for availability and currentPrice before profile/register.

### POST /api/check
Check availability and pricing. Auth: x402/MPP. Use when the user already picked one exact domain — not for multi-TLD discovery (use POST /api/search instead).
Body: { "domain": "example.com" }
Response: { domain, available, currentPrice, tld, profile?, readyToRegister?, next, ... } — ignore basePrice, bondingMultiplier, dailySlotsRemaining in user-facing text.
When available is true, includes wallet (informational — do not ask the user) and profile readiness for the paying wallet. If readyToRegister is true, do not collect ICANN contact — follow next.register after user confirms purchase.
If available is false, the domain cannot be registered.
When reporting to the user, quote only: available/not, domain, currentPrice (registration total), and TLD. Do not mention base price, bonding multiplier, or daily slots remaining.
After user confirms purchase: if readyToRegister is false, collect profile via POST /api/profile + verify-email; then register.
**Rate limit:** Shares a global 1-per-10-seconds Porkbun quota with registration pre-checks. Do not fire parallel /api/check calls — serialize them. On HTTP 503, read `retryAfter` (seconds) and wait before retrying.

### POST /api/register
Register a domain. Auth: x402/MPP. Last step — requires verified profile from steps 2–3.
Body: { "domain": "example.com" } only. Owner wallet is taken from the x402/MPP payment — never ask the user for wallet and never include wallet in the body. Never include firstName, email, or address.
Response: { domain, status, registrationEmailSent, next }
Usually synchronous (~3s). If status is "pending", poll GET /api/domain/status until "active".
Registration publishes a _stabledomains TXT record: stabledomains-owner=v1;wallet={ownerWallet}

### GET /api/domain/verify?domain=example.com
Public ownership attestation lookup. No auth.
Reads _stabledomains.{domain} TXT from public DNS.
Response: { domain, verified, attestation: { recordName, wallet, value }, registeredWithStableDomains, status? }
Optional query: wallet=0x... adds walletMatches: true|false.
Poll until verified is true after registration (DNS propagation may take minutes).

### POST /api/domain/renew
Renew for 1-10 years. Auth: x402/MPP.
Body: { "domain": "example.com", "count": 3 }
count defaults to 1. Price = per-year renewal price × count.

### GET /api/domain/list
List domains owned by authenticated wallet. Auth: SIWX.
Response: array of { domain, status, expiresAt, daysRemaining, renewalPrice, icannVerified }

### GET /api/domain/status?domain=example.com
Registration status and DNS propagation. Auth: SIWX.
Response: { domain, status, nsPropagated, nameservers, dnsRecords, expiresAt }
After registration, poll until nsPropagated is true before configuring DNS.

### GET/POST /api/domain/dns
Read or modify DNS records. Auth: SIWX.
GET query: ?domain=example.com
POST body: { "domain": "example.com", "action": "upsert"|"delete", "records": [{ "type": "A", "name": "example.com", "value": "1.2.3.4", "ttl": 300 }] }
Supported types: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV, CAA. NS cannot be modified.
The _stabledomains.{domain} TXT attestation is owner-editable (upsert only, not deletable) and syncs ownerWallet when updated.
Attestation format: stabledomains-owner=v1;wallet={address}
MX values include priority (e.g., "10 mail.example.com"). ttl defaults to 300.

### POST /api/domain/transfer-out
Transfer to another registrar. Auth: SIWX.
Body: { "domain": "example.com" }
60-day lock after registration per ICANN policy.

## TLDs and Pricing
- Purchasable TLDs (28): .com, .org, .net, .info, .biz, .co, .me, .mobi, .name, .tv, .uk, .cloud, .shop, .store, .tech, .online, .site, .pro, .email, .studio, .page, .link, .live, .xyz, .dev, .app, .io, .ai
- .com/.org/.net/.info/.biz/.co/.me/.mobi/.name/.uk: $20 reg, $20 renew, $0.01 check
- .cloud/.shop/.store/.tech/.online/.site/.pro/.email/.studio/.page/.link/.live/.xyz: $20 reg, $20 renew, $0.05 check
- .tv: $40 reg, $40 renew, $0.01 check
- .dev/.app: $25 reg, $25 renew, $0.05 check
- .io: $85 reg, $85 renew, $0.05 check
- .ai: $150 reg, $150 renew, $0.05 check
- POST /api/search: $0.01 flat (one row per supported TLD)

## Bonding Curve (internal — do not quote to users)
Prices increase as daily slots fill (max 10/day): slots 1-5 at 1.0x, 6-7 at 1.5x, 8-9 at 2.5x, slot 10 at 5.0x. Users only see currentPrice from /api/check.

wellKnown.instructions:
# StableMerch API

StableMerch is a custom merch API for making custom shirts, custom t-shirts, heavyweight shirts, and mugs from provided images. Use the preview-prepare-commit flow: create a preview draft first with SIWX, immediately show the Printify preview images, prepare the unpaid Printify order only after the user approves the preview, then pay only after the order is prepared.

## Required Flow

1. GET /api/catalog
   Browse supported products and variants. Current products are:
   - shirt
   - heavyweight-shirt
   - mug

2. POST /api/drafts with SIWX
   Create or resume an unpaid draft. The request must include:
   - client_request_id: idempotency key for this intended order
   - product_slug: shirt, heavyweight-shirt, or mug
   - image_url: HTTP/HTTPS URL or base64 data URL
   - product options such as size, color, placement when applicable
   - optional commission_address and commission_rate

   Do not ask for shipping address, phone, or email before this step. StableMerch validates the product options, uploads the image to Printify, and creates a Printify product for mockup previews. No Printify order is created and no payment is requested during draft creation.

   A successful preview draft returns status preview_ready, preview_urls, prepare_order_url, and commit_url: null. Immediately render the preview_urls as Markdown image embeds for the user. Do not respond with only text, IDs, bare links, or commit instructions. If the client supports image sizing, render preview embeds at about 300px wide. The first preview_url is usually the primary/front mockup; show it using Markdown image syntax:
   ![Front view](<first preview_url>)

   Then show 1-2 additional useful angles as Markdown image embeds:
   ![Left view](<left preview_url>)
   ![Right view](<right preview_url>)
   ![Context view](<context preview_url>)

   Do not paste bare preview URLs for the primary/front, left, or right previews. If there are many preview_urls, embed the primary/front preview plus the best 1-2 alternate angles at about 300px wide when the client supports sizing, and optionally mention that more preview angles are available. This applies to both shirts and mugs. After showing the images, ask whether the user is happy with the draft and wants to buy it, wants to modify it by creating a new draft, or wants to cancel it.

3. GET /api/drafts/{draftId} with SIWX
   Inspect draft status, preview_urls, selected options, price, expiration, prepare_order_url, commit_url, and printify_order_id. If preview_urls are present, render the primary/front preview and 1-2 useful alternate angles as Markdown image embeds with descriptive alt text. If the client supports image sizing, keep these embeds about 300px wide. Do not paste bare URLs for those primary previews. Then ask whether the user is happy and wants to buy, wants to modify the product by creating a new draft, or wants to cancel. Only discuss prepare-order after the user has seen the images and explicitly says they are happy with the preview. Only discuss or call commit after status is order_ready and commit_url is non-null.

4. POST /api/drafts/{draftId}/prepare-order with SIWX
   Call this only after the user has seen the preview images and says they want to buy. Collect UCP buyer and fulfillment shipping/contact details at this point, including buyer.email and phone_number. Clients may autofill buyer/fulfillment from an address book, but the user should review it before submission. Body must include { "draft_id": "<same draft id from URL>", "buyer": { ... }, "fulfillment": { "methods": [{ "type": "shipping", "selected_destination_id": "ship_to", "destinations": [{ "id": "ship_to", ... }] }] } }. StableMerch creates the Manual-approval Printify order for the existing preview product and returns status order_ready, printify_order_id, commit_url, optional checkout_session, and prepare_order_url: null. This step is unpaid.

5. POST /api/drafts/{draftId}/retry with SIWX
   Retry a failed retryable draft. Reuse this when Printify returns 429 or a temporary error. StableMerch resumes from the last stored Printify preview side effect and does not recreate stored uploads or products.

6. POST /api/drafts/{draftId}/cancel with SIWX
   Cancel an unpaid draft when the user does not like the preview or no longer wants the order. If a Printify order exists, StableMerch cancels it before marking the draft cancelled. Do not use cancel for committed or paid drafts.

7. POST /api/drafts/{draftId}/commit with x402 or mpp
   Body must be { "draft_id": "<same draft id from URL>" }. This is the only paid step. Use it only when status is order_ready. StableMerch sends the existing Printify order to production after payment verification. If checkout_session is present, clients can use it to render the high-intent review UI and then call its complete handler, which points at this same paid commit URL.

8. GET /api/drafts or GET /api/drafts/{draftId} with SIWX
   Recover previous drafts, committed orders, or drafts needing review.

## Idempotency

POST /api/drafts requires client_request_id. Reuse the same client_request_id only when retrying the exact same intended draft. Reusing it with different input returns a conflict.

Commit is idempotent by draft_id. If a draft is already committed, calling commit again returns the stored committed result rather than creating another Printify order.

Cancel is idempotent by draft_id. If a draft is already cancelled, calling cancel again returns the stored cancelled result.

## UCP Shipping Fulfillment

prepare-order accepts UCP buyer plus fulfillment metadata. Use buyer.email for the contact email. The selected shipping destination must include:
- id
- first_name/last_name or full_name split into first/last names
- phone_number: required for Printify shipping
- address_country: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US
- address_region: state/province code
- street_address
- extended_address: optional
- address_locality
- postal_code

When EasyPost is configured, prepare-order validates the shipping address before creating the Printify order. Address validation errors return 400 and leave the draft in preview_ready so the agent can retry with corrected fulfillment.

400 address errors use this JSON shape: { "success": false, "error": "<code>", "message": "<human-readable>", "details": { ... } }.

INVALID_ADDRESS example:
{ "success": false, "error": "INVALID_ADDRESS", "message": "Shipping address could not be verified", "details": { "easypost_code": "E.ADDRESS.NOT_FOUND", "submitted_address": { "first_name", "last_name", "email", "phone", "country", "region", "address1", "address2", "city", "zip" } } }

ADDRESS_CORRECTION_REQUIRED example:
{ "success": false, "error": "ADDRESS_CORRECTION_REQUIRED", "message": "EasyPost normalized the shipping address; update fulfillment and retry prepare-order", "details": { "submitted_address": { ... }, "suggested_address": { ... }, "changed_fields": ["zip"] } }

- 400 INVALID_ADDRESS — fix the shipping destination and retry prepare-order with the same draft_id
- 400 ADDRESS_CORRECTION_REQUIRED — read details.suggested_address, map address1/address2/city/region/zip/country back into fulfillment.methods[].destinations[] (street_address, extended_address, address_locality, address_region, postal_code, address_country), then retry prepare-order
- EasyPost outages are fail-open — prepare-order proceeds with the submitted address when verification is unavailable

## Commissions

Draft creation accepts optional commission fields. When provided, commission is added on top of the base price and forwarded after the paid commit settles.

- commission_address: EVM wallet address
- commission_rate: decimal between 0 and 1, e.g. 0.1 for 10%

## Important Notes

Do not call old direct product endpoints. StableMerch orders must use previews and drafts so the user can inspect the product before providing shipping/contact details and before payment.

Never ask for shipping/contact details before preview creation. Never present payment as the next action before displaying the preview images. Never call commit while commit_url is null. The correct next action after a successful preview draft is: show the mockup images using Markdown image syntax, then ask whether the user is happy and wants to buy, wants to modify the product by creating a new draft, or wants to cancel.

checkout_session is display/flow metadata, not the source of truth for payment terms. The paid commit challenge still supplies the exact x402/MPP payment options.

When present after prepare-order, checkout_session includes UCP buyer and fulfillment metadata that mirrors the prepared buyer/fulfillment input. Clients with address books should map their stored address into UCP fulfillment for prepare-order, then render checkout_session.fulfillment as the final shipping review before commit.

# StableEmail — Pay-per-send email via micropayments > Send email with a single HTTP request. No API keys. No accounts. Pay $0.02 per email. ## Base URL https://stableemail.dev ## Discovery GET /openapi.json ## Endpoints ### POST /api/send — Send email (shared domain) - Protection: x402/MPP payment ($0.02 USDC on Base, Solana, or Tempo) - Sends from: relay@stableemail.dev - Body: { "to": ["email"], "cc": ["email"], "subject": "string", "html": "string", "text": "string", "replyTo": "email", "attachments": [{"content": "base64...", "contentType": "application/pdf", "filename": "file.pdf"}] } - Requires either "html" or "text" (or both) - "attachments" is optional, max 5, each with base64 content (~3.75MB decoded limit), MIME contentType, and filename - For calendar invites (.ics), use contentType: "text/calendar; method=REQUEST" - Returns: { "success": true, "messageId": "string", "from": "string" } ### POST /api/subdomain/buy — Purchase a custom subdomain - Protection: x402/MPP payment ($5 USDC) - Body: { "subdomain": "yourname" } - Subdomain rules: 3-30 chars, lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens - Creates yourname.stableemail.dev with full email sending capability - DNS verification takes ~5 minutes after purchase - Returns: { "success": true, "subdomain": "yourname.stableemail.dev", "dnsStatus": "pending" } ### POST /api/subdomain/send — Send from custom subdomain - Protection: x402/MPP payment ($0.005 USDC) - Payer wallet must be owner or authorized signer for the subdomain - Body: { "from": "you@yourname.stableemail.dev", "to": ["email"], "cc": ["email"], "subject": "string", "html": "string", "text": "string", "replyTo": "email" } - Returns: { "success": true, "messageId": "string", "from": "string" } ### POST /api/subdomain/signers — Manage authorized wallets - Protection: SIWX wallet proof only (free, no payment) - Only the subdomain owner can manage signers - Body: { "action": "add" | "remove", "subdomain": "yourname", "walletAddress": "0x..." } - Max 50 signers per subdomain ### POST /api/subdomain/update — Update subdomain settings - Protection: SIWX wallet proof only (free, no payment) - Only the subdomain owner can update - Body: { "subdomain": "yourname", "catchAllForwardTo": "catch-all@example.com" } - Set catchAllForwardTo to null to remove catch-all forwarding - Catch-all forwards emails to unmatched addresses on the subdomain ### GET /api/subdomain/status?subdomain=yourname — Check subdomain status - Protection: SIWX wallet proof only (free, no payment) - Owner or any signer can check status - Returns: { "subdomain": "string", "ownerWallet": "string", "dnsVerified": bool, "sesVerified": bool, "signerCount": number, "signers": ["0x..."] } ## Subdomain Inboxes — Receive Email on Subdomains Subdomain owners can create per-address inboxes on their subdomain (e.g., `biden@craig.stableemail.dev`). $0.25 to create (x402/MPP payment), cap 100 per subdomain. Each inbox optionally forwards to a real address and/or retains messages for programmatic API access. Unmatched addresses go to the subdomain's catch-all forwarder if set, otherwise silently dropped. ### POST /api/subdomain/inbox/create — Create inbox on subdomain ($0.25) - Protection: x402/MPP payment ($0.25 USDC on Base, Solana, or Tempo) - Payer wallet must be the subdomain owner - Body: { "subdomain": "craig", "localPart": "biden", "forwardTo": "joe@gmail.com" } - forwardTo is optional — omit for programmatic-only mailbox (retainMessages auto-enabled) - Max 100 inboxes per subdomain, 500 messages per inbox - Returns: { "success": true, "inbox": "biden@craig.stableemail.dev", "retainMessages": true, "messageLimit": 500 } ### POST /api/subdomain/inbox/list — List subdomain inboxes - Protection: SIWX wallet proof only (free, no payment) - Only the subdomain owner can list - Body: { "subdomain": "craig" } - Returns: { "success": true, "inboxes": [{ "localPart": "string", "address": "string", "forwardTo": "string?", "retainMessages": bool, "active": bool, "messageCount": number, "unreadCount": number }] } ### POST /api/subdomain/inbox/update — Update inbox settings - Protection: SIWX wallet proof only (free, no payment) - Only the subdomain owner can update - Body: { "subdomain": "craig", "localPart": "biden", "forwardTo": "newemail@example.com", "retainMessages": true } - At least one of "forwardTo" or "retainMessages" is required - Set forwardTo to null to remove forwarding - Returns: { "success": true, "inbox": "biden@craig.stableemail.dev", "forwardTo": "string?", "retainMessages": bool } ### POST /api/subdomain/inbox/delete — Delete inbox from subdomain - Protection: SIWX wallet proof only (free, no payment) - Only the subdomain owner can delete - Body: { "subdomain": "craig", "localPart": "biden" } - Cascades: deletes all messages from DB and S3 - Returns: { "success": true, "deleted": "biden@craig.stableemail.dev", "messagesDeleted": number } ### POST /api/subdomain/inbox/messages — List inbox messages - Protection: x402/MPP payment ($0.001 USDC on Base, Solana, or Tempo) - Payer wallet must be the subdomain owner - Body: { "subdomain": "craig", "localPart": "biden", "cursor": "message id (optional)", "limit": 20 } - Returns: { "success": true, "messages": [...], "nextCursor": "string?", "messageCount": number, "messageLimit": 500, "warning": "string?" } - Warning field appears when inbox is at or near capacity (>=80%). Delete old messages to free space. ### POST /api/subdomain/inbox/messages/read — Read a single message - Protection: x402/MPP payment ($0.001 USDC on Base, Solana, or Tempo) - Payer wallet must be the subdomain owner - Body: { "messageId": "string" } - Returns: { "success": true, "message": { "id": "string", "from": "string", "to": ["string"], "subject": "string", "date": "ISO date", "text": "string", "html": "string", "attachments": [{ "filename": "string", "contentType": "string", "size": number }], "receivedAt": "ISO date" } } - Marks the message as read ### POST /api/subdomain/inbox/messages/delete — Delete a message - Protection: SIWX wallet proof only (free, no payment) - Only the subdomain owner can delete messages - Body: { "messageId": "string" } - Returns: { "success": true, "deleted": "string" } ## Forwarding Inbox Buy `username@stableemail.dev` for $1/month. Use it as a forwarding inbox (emails forwarded to your real address), a programmatic mailbox (read messages via API), or both. You can also send from your inbox address. Duration-based pricing with bulk discounts. Anyone can top up any inbox. Cancel anytime for a pro-rata refund. ### POST /api/inbox/buy — Buy an inbox ($1, 30 days) - Protection: x402/MPP payment ($1 USDC on Base, Solana, or Tempo) - Body: { "username": "alice", "forwardTo": "alice@gmail.com" } - forwardTo is optional — omit it to use as a programmatic mailbox (retainMessages enabled automatically, read messages via /api/inbox/messages) - Username rules: 3-30 chars, lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens - Subdomain owners can buy the matching inbox name (e.g., owner of alice.stableemail.dev can buy alice@stableemail.dev) - Returns: { "success": true, "inbox": "alice@stableemail.dev", "retainMessages": true, "expiresAt": "ISO date", "daysRemaining": 30 } ### POST /api/inbox/topup — Top up inbox 30 days ($1) - Protection: x402/MPP payment ($1 USDC) - Anyone can top up any inbox — no SIWX required - Body: { "username": "alice" } - Returns: { "success": true, "inbox": "alice", "expiresAt": "ISO date", "daysRemaining": number, "daysAdded": 30 } ### POST /api/inbox/topup/quarter — Top up inbox 90 days ($2.50, save 17%) - Protection: x402/MPP payment ($2.50 USDC) - Anyone can top up any inbox — no SIWX required - Body: { "username": "alice" } - Returns: { "success": true, "inbox": "alice", "expiresAt": "ISO date", "daysRemaining": number, "daysAdded": 90 } ### POST /api/inbox/topup/year — Top up inbox 365 days ($8, save 34%) - Protection: x402/MPP payment ($8 USDC) - Anyone can top up any inbox — no SIWX required - Body: { "username": "alice" } - Returns: { "success": true, "inbox": "alice", "expiresAt": "ISO date", "daysRemaining": number, "daysAdded": 365 } ### POST /api/inbox/send — Send from your inbox address ($0.005) - Protection: x402/MPP payment ($0.005 USDC) - Payer wallet must be the inbox owner - Body: { "username": "alice", "to": ["bob@example.com"], "cc": ["carol@example.com"], "subject": "Hello", "html": "

Hi

", "text": "Hi", "replyTo": "alice@gmail.com" } - Requires either "html" or "text" (or both) - Returns: { "success": true, "messageId": "string", "from": "alice@stableemail.dev" } ### GET /api/inbox/status?username=alice — Check inbox status - Protection: SIWX wallet proof only (free, no payment) - Only the inbox owner can check status - Returns: { "inbox": "alice@stableemail.dev", "ownerWallet": "0x...", "forwardTo": "email", "retainMessages": bool, "expiresAt": "ISO date", "daysRemaining": number, "daysOwned": number, "active": bool, "pricing": {...} } ### GET /api/inbox/list — List all inboxes owned by the authenticated wallet - Protection: SIWX wallet proof only (free, no payment) - Returns both standalone inboxes and subdomain inboxes for the caller's wallet - Returns: { "success": true, "walletAddress": "0x...", "standaloneInboxes": [{ "username": "string", "address": "string", "forwardTo": "string?", "retainMessages": bool, "active": bool, "expiresAt": "ISO date", "daysRemaining": number, "messageCount": number, "unreadCount": number, "createdAt": "ISO date" }], "subdomains": [{ "subdomain": "string", "inboxes": [{ "localPart": "string", "address": "string", "forwardTo": "string?", "retainMessages": bool, "active": bool, "messageCount": number, "unreadCount": number, "createdAt": "ISO date" }] }] } ### POST /api/inbox/update — Update inbox settings - Protection: SIWX wallet proof only (free, no payment) - Only the inbox owner can update - Body: { "username": "alice", "forwardTo": "newemail@example.com", "retainMessages": true } - At least one of "forwardTo" or "retainMessages" is required - "retainMessages": when true, inbound emails are kept in S3 for programmatic access via the messages API - Returns: { "success": true, "inbox": "alice@stableemail.dev", "forwardTo": "newemail@example.com", "retainMessages": true } ### POST /api/inbox/cancel — Cancel inbox and get pro-rata USDC refund - Protection: SIWX wallet proof only (free, no payment) - Only the inbox owner can cancel - Body: { "username": "alice" } - Refund is sent on-chain to the caller's wallet automatically - Refunds below $0.01 are waived (too small to transfer) - Returns: { "success": true, "inbox": "alice@stableemail.dev", "cancelled": true, "refund": { "amount": "0.50", "currency": "USDC", "network": "eip155:8453", "to": "0x...", "status": "completed", "transactionHash": "0x..." }, "daysRemaining": 15 } ## Inbox Messages API Read inbound emails programmatically. Requires "retainMessages": true on the inbox (set via POST /api/inbox/update). ### POST /api/inbox/messages — List messages - Protection: x402/MPP payment ($0.001 USDC on Base, Solana, or Tempo) - Payer wallet must be the inbox owner - Body: { "username": "alice", "cursor": "message id (optional)", "limit": 20 } - Returns: { "success": true, "messages": [{ "id": "string", "fromEmail": "string", "subject": "string", "receivedAt": "ISO date", "read": bool }], "nextCursor": "message id (optional)" } - Paginated: pass "nextCursor" as "cursor" in the next request ### POST /api/inbox/messages/read — Read a single message - Protection: x402/MPP payment ($0.001 USDC on Base, Solana, or Tempo) - Payer wallet must be the inbox owner - Body: { "messageId": "string" } - Returns: { "success": true, "message": { "id": "string", "from": "string", "to": ["string"], "subject": "string", "date": "ISO date", "text": "string", "html": "string", "attachments": [{ "filename": "string", "contentType": "string", "size": number }], "receivedAt": "ISO date" } } - Marks the message as read ### POST /api/inbox/messages/delete — Delete a message - Protection: SIWX wallet proof only (free, no payment) - Only the inbox owner can delete messages - Body: { "messageId": "string" } - Removes the message from DB and S3 storage - Returns: { "success": true, "deleted": "string" } ## Images in Emails To include images, use `` in the "html" body. Host images on stableupload.dev (x402/MPP-powered file uploads, see https://stableupload.dev/llms.txt). Upload via x402/MPP payment → get a public URL → reference in HTML. Prefer hosted URLs over base64 data URIs — most email clients strip data URIs. ## Agent Integration The recommended way for AI agents to interact with StableEmail is via [agentcash-skills](https://github.com/Merit-Systems/agentcash-skills) — available as an MCP server (`npx -y agentcash@latest`) or CLI (`npx agentcash fetch ...`). It handles payment negotiation and retry logic automatically. Any x402/MPP-compatible client paying USDC on Base, Solana, or Tempo will also work. ## Payment Details - Network: Base (eip155:8453), Solana, or Tempo - Currency: USDC - Protocol: x402 (https://www.x402.org) / MPP (https://mpp.dev) - Send first request → receive 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED header → sign payment → resend with payment header ## SIWX Authentication Free management endpoints (status, update, cancel, signers) use SIWX for wallet identity verification. These endpoints return a 402 with SIWX challenge in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (same flow as x402/MPP payment). x402/MPP-compatible clients (like agentcash) handle this automatically — no special handling needed. Paid send endpoints identify the wallet from the x402/MPP payment header instead. SIWX is part of the x402/MPP protocol extensions (CAIP-122 compliant, supports EVM + Solana).
